class.documentation: A community is a group of people that share a natural language and have a shared set of terms used to express concepts in their domain of interest. We refer to a set of terms that is distinguished from general use of the natural language as a vernacular. The community may be persons that share a profession, are members of the same enterprise or organization or are collaborating on a particular technology.
